note: "Das konnte ich fuer einen IT-ler noch nie." is not idiomatic self-contained German; "fuer einen IT-ler" reads as "on behalf of an IT guy" rather than the intended "as an IT guy", and "Das" has no antecedent. The gloss inherits the same confusion.
Etoile Carouge is a football club, so the gloss should read "re-establishing itself", not "himself". Gaps are unaffected.
